newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-WOLVES GET ROBERTS FROM CLIPPERS FOR VRANKOVIC.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-WOLVES GET ROBERTS FROM CLIPPERS FOR VRANKOVIC.

text.p: The Minnesota Timberwolves acquired Stanley Roberts from the Los Angeles Clippers Wednesday night in exchange for Croatian Stoyko Vrankovic in a swap of journeyman centres.

The 7-2 (2.18 metres) Vrankovic averaged 3.4 points and 3.2 rebounds for the Timberwolves last season. He also blocked 1.2 shots per game but his lack of mobility often got him in foul trouble and he lost his starting job to the smaller Dean Garrett.
Vrankovic, 33, has two years remaining on his contract. He played from 1990 to 1992 with the Boston Celtics.

The 27-year-old, 7-foot (2.13 metres) played just 18 games last season, again limited by injuries. He averaged 9.5 points and 3.7 rebounds. Plagued by weight problems throughout his career, he has missed 245 games in the last four seasons, mostly with Achilles tendon injuries.

Roberts joins his third NBA team, spending one season with the Orlando Magic and five with the Clippers. His best season was 1992-93 in Los Angeles, when he averaged 11.3 points and 6.1 rebounds in a career-high 77 games. He is entering the final year of his contract.
